机制概述: Trias has 6 Embellishment Cards, 3 Beginnings and 3 Endings. He can use these to enhance his attacks’ powers and names. The longer his attack however, the slower he will be!

效果.效果: Setup: You have 6 inactive Embellishments (3 Beginnings and 3 Endings). Embellishments in your supply are always hidden from Opponents.
<o-b>Limited Ante:</o-b> Select a <i-sb>Beginning</i-sb>. It is activated when you reveal your Attack Pair.
<o-b>Limited Ante:</o-b> Select an <i-sb>Ending</i-sb>. It is activated when you reveal your Attack Pair.
Reveal, 1+ active Embellishments: -3 Priority if you have 2 active Embellishments. Otherwise, -1 Priority. Revealed Embellishments are applied to your attack.
Recycle: Put any Embellishments in Discard Pile 2 into your supply. Put any Embellishments in Discard Pile 1 into Discard Pile 2. Put any active Embellishments into Discard Pile 1.
